Vivek / Monica — reviewed Jane's export. Quick summary of technical approach and constraints: 

Planned approach
- Locate conversation by convo_id present in conversation_export_ARC113.json across three zones: ingestion index (real-time telemetry), analytics derived-tables (daily batch), and our operational audit index.
- Perform targeted delete (delete-by-id) on active indexes. Verify via checksum and a secondary scan.
- For derived tables, regenerate any materialized view if the deleted row impacts aggregates (we will mark the repair window).

Backups and immutable snapshots
- Our cold snapshots are retained for 90 days. If the customer requires removal from immutable backups, we'll need Legal approval and a formal retention exception; that process can take multiple business days.

Required approvals
- Legal signoff for removal from snapshots (if requested) — cc Marissa for intake.
- SRE ops runbook signoff (I will prepare a short checklist).

ETA
- Active indexes: 24–36 hours after we get written confirmation from Arcadia to proceed.
- Snapshots: TBD (requires legal + ops window).

I'll attach a short removal_checklist_v1.pdf we use for these ops.
